source_units.text: Write an origin story for an imaginary soap package.
The intended readers are shoppers reading a fictional craft label.
I want a warm and understated tone.
The total word count must fall from 50 to 80, inclusive.
Include the following invented details: Harbor Thread began as an imaginary soap workshop using empty cedar boxes as molds.
Its maker marks every bar with a spiral stamp to recall the curled wood shavings on the first workbench.
Preserve these exact phrases: "Harbor Thread", "cedar boxes", "a spiral stamp".
